perche: Z-C21, finding M11, measured REAL by Z-C21.3 on 28/9/2026 (probe_sketch_picture_4096 and probe_sketch_picture2). immagine_nello_schizzo (OperazioniRicalco.cs) computed mm_per_pixel as larghezza_mm / the width GetPixelmapSize returns. Over 2048 px SOLIDWORKS compresses the picture: ISketchManager~InsertSketchPicture2.html, «false to compress images to 2048 pixels before insertion», and «If the document type is not a drawing, then HighestResolution defaults to false»; the probes found HighestResolution = true ignored in a part as well. So on a 4096 px file the bridge published mm_per_pixel twice the true one, and its own scale check passed, because it was computed with the same 2048. The fix reads the pixel size from the file header: «pixel» and «mm_per_pixel» are the file's, «solidworks_pixels» is the map SOLIDWORKS holds, the scale check stays on that map, and «compression» says when the two differ.
il_difetto_che_questo_caso_prende: A scale per pixel off by the compression factor (0.2 instead of 0.1 mm per pixel here), believed because the check used the same wrong pixel count: every point traced from the file would land at twice its distance from the corner.
i_numeri: Banco/dati/trace_4096x2048.png is the probe's picture: 4096 x 2048, white, a black border and diagonal, the first column red and the last blue (35518 bytes). larghezza_mm 409.6 = 4096 file pixels x 0.1 mm, corner at 10, 20. The probe measured, with InsertSketchPicture and with InsertSketchPicture2 true or false: GetPixelmapSize 2048 x 1024; SetSize to 409.6 x 204.8 mm; pixel (0,0) at (10, 224.8) and pixel (2047,0) at (419.4, 224.8), 409.4 mm apart = 2047 x 0.2. The old mm_per_pixel: 409.6 / 2048 = 0.2, and the last column of the file (4095) at 10 + 4095 x 0.2 = 829 mm instead of 10 + 4095 x 0.1 = 419.5 mm. Files of 1000 x 500 and 2048 x 1024 kept their size with every call (the 400 x 200 of la_foto_sta_in_scala stays as it was).
